name: station-g20-v4.2
notes: Supersedes station-left-g20-v2. Values measured by the user on 2026-10-15 (references/station_measurements.md); world frame stays the station URDF world, anchored to the table plate.
table: plate 625 x 1250 mm (B2, B1 measured = design), top 767 mm above floor (A), 10 mm thick (B3); x/y edges from the URDF plate.

left_arm.base_pose: z = table top + 495 mm (D1, base axis); y = column centre (table left edge + 560 + 120/2 mm, C1/C2) + 182/2 mm (mount face to mount face, assumed symmetric); x = column centre with the column front flush with the plate back edge (C3) and the URDF column depth 113 mm (C5 not measured, +-5 mm). Orientation is the URDF design value.

left_hand.mount: 20 mm from the AR5 flange face (black ring top = URDF tcp, link7 mesh end) to the G20 bottom (hand_base_link origin), measured (E1); the +90 deg yaw is the L25 value, unverified for G20 (E2), so mount_status stays unverified.

left_arm.home_q and gamepad.root_pose come from scripts/place_gamepad_ik.py (runs/20261015-gamepad-placement-ik/placement_chosen_hc0.015.json): gamepad face up, centre 380 mm from the plate back edge, laterally centred (y = plate centre), yaw -90 deg about z so the bumpers point away from the robot like a player's grip; home_q places the palm at all-clear thumb-reach placement 1068 (alpha = 0, open fingers clear of the gamepad), open hand 48 mm and arm meshes 226 mm above the table top, min joint-limit margin 0.61 rad. Kinematic choice; contacts are checked in SAPIEN (docs/reports/2026-10-15-workstation-sapien-check).
Right self-collision disabled independently of left; inter-arm and fixtures collisions enabled.

right home_q assumed: Task G grid search, fold palm within 0.45m of right base, then minimize Euclidean distance to AR5 zero. Not measured parking pose; replace after user video. Reviewer ruling1 exempts only AR5_5_07R_W4C4A2_base vs station_column and station_column_top_mount. All other clearance lower bounds >=50mm. See 2026-10-16-twin-v4-fixes/parking_certificate.json.
腕相机于 2026-10-16 前已拆除，见 references/linkerhand_station.md。当前仅保留立柱顶 RealSense（camera_3/ego），序列号 camera_3 已由审阅者于 2026-10-16 现场确认，与8月数据 camera_3 是同一设备；v4保留三相机历史配置。
ego外参和相机外壳位姿沿用8月数据的粗配准，当时的安装位置可能与现在不同；待用户当前场景录像重新标定。设备序列号一致不证明安装外参一致。D435 mesh-to-optical offset remains nominal.
v4.2 only updates ego camera and its visual shell: height1.492m, camera_info1280x720 K, approximate pitch; 待标定板标定。v4.1 physical and parking parameters retained.
